en: A vintage postcard featuring a black-and-white photograph of a large, ornate building with timber framing and a pointed tower, surrounded by trees and a garden area. A bench and some garden features are visible in the foreground. The caption reads 'Christliches Hospiz Pyrmont.' The reverse side includes handwritten German text, address information, a green stamp labeled 'Deutsches Reich', a postmark from 'PYRMONT', and a printed marking for 'MUSEUM IM SCHLOSS BAD PYRMONT'.
